# stripe_promotion_code (Resource)

A customer-facing code that redeems a coupon. `terraform destroy` archives the promotion code, because Stripe cannot delete one. An archived code keeps its `code`, so it cannot be used for another promotion code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_coupon" "launch" {
  percent_off = 10
  duration    = "once"
}

resource "stripe_promotion_code" "launch" {
  code            = "LAUNCH10"
  max_redemptions = 100

  promotion = {
    type   = "coupon"
    coupon = stripe_coupon.launch.id
  }

  restrictions = {
    first_time_transaction  = true
    minimum_amount          = 1000
    minimum_amount_currency = "usd"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `promotion` (Attributes) The promotion referenced by this promotion code. Changing it replaces the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--promotion))

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the promotion code is currently active.
- `code` (String) The customer-facing code. Regardless of case, this code must be unique across all active promotion codes for a specific customer. Valid characters are lower case letters (a-z), upper case letters (A-Z), digits (0-9), and dashes (-). If left blank, we will generate one automatically. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `customer` (String) The customer who can use this promotion code. If not set, all customers can use the promotion code. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `customer_account` (String) The account representing the customer who can use this promotion code. If not set, all customers can use the promotion code. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `expires_at` (Number) The timestamp at which this promotion code will expire. If the coupon has specified a `redeems_by`, then this value cannot be after the coupon's `redeems_by`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `max_redemptions` (Number) A positive integer specifying the number of times the promotion code can be redeemed. If the coupon has specified a `max_redemptions`, then this value cannot be greater than the coupon's `max_redemptions`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.
- `restrictions` (Attributes) Settings that restrict the redemption of the promotion code. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created` (Number) Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `times_redeemed` (Number) Number of times this promotion code has been used.

<a id="nestedatt--promotion"></a>
### Nested Schema for `promotion`

Required:

- `type` (String) The type of promotion. Possible values: `coupon`.

Optional:

- `coupon` (String) If promotion `type` is `coupon`, the coupon for this promotion.


<a id="nestedatt--restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions`

Optional:

- `currency_options` (Attributes Map) Promotion code restrictions defined in each available currency option. Each key must be a three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) and a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions--currency_options))
- `first_time_transaction` (Boolean) A Boolean indicating if the Promotion Code should only be redeemed for Customers without any successful payments or invoices Changing it replaces the resource.
- `minimum_amount` (Number) Minimum amount required to redeem this Promotion Code into a Coupon (e.g., a purchase must be $100 or more to work). Changing it replaces the resource.
- `minimum_amount_currency` (String) Three-letter [ISO code](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies) for minimum_amount Changing it replaces the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--restrictions--currency_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions.currency_options`

Optional:

- `minimum_amount` (Number) Minimum amount required to redeem this Promotion Code into a Coupon (e.g., a purchase must be $100 or more to work).



<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import stripe_promotion_code.launch promo_123
```
